Cache successful MVC indexer metadata weakly outside Hot Reload

## Description

**Fork-only allocation-focused draft; not merge-ready.**

Cache a successful `ExpressionHelper.IsSingleArgumentIndexer` classification
in a weak ephemeron table keyed by its actual getter `MethodInfo`.
Keep negative/custom reflection cases on the original discovery path.
Bypass both lookup and publication whenever `MetadataUpdater.IsSupported`,
instead of introducing a cache that needs invalidation in that process.
Do not cache expression text or captured index values.

The exact two-file proposal is +156/-0: 15 product lines and 141 test lines.
Existing statements,branches,public/protected surface,API baselines,TFMs,
dependencies and visibility grants remain unchanged. No new cross-framework
non-public access or handler. The existing owner is not packable.

### Actual measured benefit and costs

The real public `ModelExpressionProvider.GetExpressionText` primary profiles
save 561-569 B/op in every pair,approximately 9-10%. Observed median paired time
improvements are 6.42% for retained captured indices and 8.37% when a new
expression is constructed. **Untouched controls also move;allocation is the
stronger result,not a causal app/request/rendering speedup claim.**

The helper-only 99% improvement and 568 B/op removal are not the public claim.
Real public index evaluation/delegate work still dominates. No HTTP,full view
rendering,production call frequency or end-to-end throughput is established.

#### Warm observed comparison

Three actual comparisons;84 native warm rows and18 first-observed observations. Positive percentage means less time.
The two primary indexed-name profiles are unchanged. Shared VM noise and controls limit timing attribution;allocation savings are the stronger result.

The original raw `Model.Indexer.Metadata` row is the runtime-type operation,not metadata-only. Reading `ModelExplorer.ModelType` evaluates its lazy model accessor for this reference model. Comparisons2/3 correct the label/flags without changing the timed operations.

#### First observed calls:fixture,JIT and metadata included

| Public profile | Original ms,1/2/3 | Selected ms,1/2/3 | Original bytes,1/2/3 | Selected bytes,1/2/3 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Name.List.Constant | 40.59 / 38.68 / 38.49 | 40.08 / 39.21 / 38.43 | 103888 / 103888 / 97744 | 104216 / 104216 / 91880 |
| Name.Member.Control | 30.35 / 28.88 / 28.15 | 29.57 / 29.49 / 29.08 | 75824 / 75824 / 75824 | 75824 / 75824 / 75824 |
| Model.Indexer.Value | 47.76 / 45.59 / 45.32 | 47.48 / 47.92 / 45.10 | 141992 / 139760 / 133616 | 139488 / 139560 / 139488 |

These are single observations,not a cold-start performance conclusion. Keep unfavorable/control observations.

All three allowed comparisons are used and permanently closed: 24 native
profiles,84 warm native reports and 18 separate first-observed calls. Order is
original/selected,selected/original,original/selected. The paired 179-file
closure differs only in the actual MVC DLL and matching PDB;harnesses match
within each pair,not across the two explicitly witnessed label versions.

The initial raw `Model.Indexer.Metadata` row was mislabeled:reading
`ModelExplorer.ModelType` materializes the lazy reference model. Comparisons2/3
correct the label/consumption flag without changing the timed operations.
The original raw profile,flag,source and consumed slot remain intact.
This is not a metadata-only benchmark.

**Adverse outcomes retained:** ordinary-method classifier time is higher
in every pair with unchanged 120 B/op;array-name time is higher every pair
with unchanged 5084 B/op. Full array-model timing swings between 6.14% lower
and 6.35% higher. First indexed-name observations add 328 bytes in comparisons 1/2.
Comparison 2's first indexed-value call is 5.12% slower;comparison 3 allocates
5872 more bytes. Single first-observed calls include fixture/JIT/metadata and
do not establish cold-start speedups or isolated cache-entry cost.

### Correctness,lifetime and live-edit boundary

The unchanged product with the four new cases passes 82/83,with only the
expected 19,200-versus-0-byte repeated-classification assertion failing.
Selected helper tests pass 83/83;the expanded actual helper/metadata-producer
scope passes 96/96,0 skipped. All 79 original outcome multiplicities,including
duplicate displayed Theory names,remain passed. New coverage checks current
captured indices,mutable custom reflection,and collectible type/method
lifetime. A compiling deliberate strong-key variant fails only lifetime.

Actual original/selected `dotnet watch` getter-body edits apply with one startup
marker and one stable app PID;retained accessors observe `before` to `after`.
Selected update-supported execution continues live discovery. A diagnostic
cache-active-under-updates owner fails `LIVE_METADATA_PATH_REQUIRED`.
That is bypass-policy sensitivity,not an observed stale classification.
C# IndexerName and VB DefaultMember declaration edits were unsupported,so
classification-changing invalidation is not claimed. Owned watchers stopped
and app PIDs checked absent.

The initial `ExpressionHelperTest` run stopped before assertions on missing
ANCM native assets;the successful actual managed owner uses
`UseIisNativeAssets=false`,not native IIS integration.
Product formatting passes. Root test formatting still reports the original
BOM `CHARSET`,reproduced on original;a separate encoding-only selected mirror
passes. Original BOM preserved;no root-file all-green formatting claim.

```powershell

```
**Actual result:exit0 in the copied standalone capsule;all84retained raw means and existing source/native/paired-output checks pass. No timing or omitted binary image reopening.**

[Every exact recorded build,test,formatter,watch and native command with actual exit code](https://github.com/jaslawinMs/aspnetcore/blob/9dd67cbac9be3c77a9a7e60a2557b0271ecd4e7c/F022/validation-commands.md).

SDK 12.0.100-alpha.1.26557.102/runtime 12.0.0-alpha.1.26562.105,C# 13,
net12/x64/server GC,BDN 0.13.0;shared Windows Hyper-V VM,not isolated.
A direct emitted executor never requests priority,affinity or power changes;
all warm before/setup/after observations remain Normal/Normal/65535.

Live verification rehashed 716 closure bindings over 186 distinct native paths.
Recorded PE/PDB identities and selected source documents match;not complete
compiler provenance or test-PDB binding. The copied portable auditor recomputes
all 84 retained raw means and paired summaries,without reopening omitted binary
images or deriving Student-t quantiles independently.

Source `c6679258a6fa3c8c72496db5d4806881890f564b` was measured as the independent baseline
`37e809ead5824bc753a1c3d56f11615bdb1296c5` plus exact retained patch before
committing. Initial default 49147673 was captured before implementation.
When default advanced to fa10021d,the source publication stopped;38 fresh
snapshots showed 14 core Git blobs and intervening path history unchanged.
`global.json`/`eng/Versions.props` differ,no SDK switch or full newer-default
integration claim. The first blocked publication preflight is retained.

**[1766 immutable evidence files](https://github.com/jaslawinMs/aspnetcore/blob/9dd67cbac9be3c77a9a7e60a2557b0271ecd4e7c/F022/README.md)** contain
the runnable standalone BDN project/helper,all controls/cold/raw reports,
source/runtime/PDB witnesses,TRX,live edits,all failed preparations,initial
label error and copied portable audit. Binary/binlog/build/package images are
omitted with exact hashes. A relocated selected standalone consumer actually
builds and passes 14 wrappers/42 contracts without a fourth comparison.
Other OS/runtime/AOT,native IIS,classification-changing live edits and
production-wide gains remain unverified.


Fixes jaslawinMs/aspnetcore#133
